question: Does the US monitor keep its accuracy when the training scenes are chosen without topple labels, by whether their own rendered futures split (image latents + the unchanged split test)?
basis: Phase 1e: US (label-free rebalancing) 81.3/14.1 on H, 82.1/8.6 on panel 7, matches R_fast within 0.03. But the training states themselves were curated with topple counts: step3b/train (step3_data.select: up to 750 topple-disagreeing screens of 1,500) and phase1/train (all topple-disagreeing screens + equal others). The training pipeline is therefore label-free only from the sampler onward.

At every chunk start: 8 futures exactly as eval/step3_data.py (true start + perception draw + bench execution snippet), each rendered with the close camera ONLY at hold 10 and hold 30 (trace indices 17, 37, as gate D0) and encoded to the channel-PCA-8 latent. selection: 4,766 states (the size of the current enriched set): all alarming starts up to 2,383 (if more, a uniform random 2,383; seed 20261121) + uniform random other starts to fill 4,766.
